name: 战斗光效升级
notice: 战斗特效全面换成新的光效版：普攻、暴击、小技能、大招和击破都有按种族区分的光效（魅族粉焰、恶魔裂隙、海灵水冠、血精灵血月），命中时有冲击帧和短暂慢镜头。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 WebGL R121: Fx1023 procedural cel-shaded battle VFX (shaders in Resources/Shaders/Fx1023*, generated by Tools/fx1023/gen_shaders.py) on every player hit and KO; gamma-authored colours converted for the linear canvas.

validation.iosSimulator: Mac build fxdemo capture checked frame by frame (all races, crit, slash, ult, defeat).

knownLimits: 海灵族的技能/大招是治疗和护盾，不打敌人，所以水冠特效只在其他攻击场合出现。
Boss 没有单独立绘挂点时不显示命中光效。
